title: The Move Black Was Counting On
setup: Black's pawn to a6 and queen to c7 have exactly one point behind them, and it has not happened yet. Stop it before it does.
hint: Ask what Black plays next if you do nothing at all, then find the move that makes that plan expensive.
explanation:
## The Idea

Black's setup points one way: {{b5}}, then the bishop to b7 and pressure down the long diagonal at e4.

{{c4}} deletes that plan. The pawn now covers b5 and d5, so the break drops material. Black develops with {{Be7}}, White completes the bind with {{Nc3}}, and there is no break left to prepare.

The price: the c-pawn can never come back to c3 to support the knight on d4. A prophylactic move nearly always costs something small. Pay it when the plan you delete is worth more.
